assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Embodied-intelligence scenarios such as delivery robots, inspection robots, AR guides, and civic agents require speed limits, spatial boundaries, visible notices, data minimization, and human takeover before public operation.
assumptions.impact: All robot and AI public-space scenarios remain conceptual pilots until safety, privacy, insurance, and operating responsibilities are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Neighborhood benefits should be tested with residents, students, older people, commuters, merchants, and innovation workers before any scenario is scaled.
assumptions.impact: Scenario expansion depends on community feedback and professional review, not on technical feasibility alone.
